parents: Each split uses the first valid competing parents from its start, and ordinary parents at start+1000. Include original and every legal +/-15 mm sibling. No cross-split parent reuse.
cells: Shared bounded two-slot scheduler. Continuous and next-detection-tick clocks. Learned structured and direct contact-state residual decoders share the tick prior, admission, materials, inputs, exact-start training intervals, supervision and sample draws. Corrections only on unique positive-time encounters. Training uses coarse reference. Choose each seed's checkpoint by validation parent-mean full-release RMSE, equal family weight.
gate: Primary deployable forecast uses a fixed 1920-Hz physics convention for both references. Against bounded continuous, require upper paired-parent 95% bound below zero at both references in either family, with under 1 mm mean regression in the other. Learned approaches must also pass against the validation-chosen analytic control. Average three prespecified seed errors before parent resampling. Run the existing fixed selector on reserved 92000/94000 families if earned. Report crossed forecast/reference rates separately.
relay_study: Known, shared prior, momentum-ratio estimate and learned mass encoder use one identical two-body solver and edit grid. Probed arms see the same quantized velocity readings from one prior probe. Every fourth parent receives an uninformative probe (both bodies stationary); analytic and learned estimators revert to the prior. Elevated receiver platform is absent from probe model selection and from the ordinary release family. Report full paths, pre-transfer locality, disabled pair and probe cost.
